en.headline: Observatory expects showers as monsoon nears after hot day
en.dek: The 6.30pm bulletin said temperatures topped 34 degrees in many places, with showers and thunderstorms overnight and a high of about 31 on Friday.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said in its 6.30pm bulletin that showers and thunderstorms triggered by high temperatures were affecting the Guangdong coast, and that many places in Hong Kong had reached 34 degrees or above during the afternoon.

Tonight and Friday were forecast to turn cloudier, with a few showers and thunderstorms. Some areas could see heavier rain on Friday, with temperatures between 27 and 31 degrees. Winds were light, becoming moderate east to northeasterly on Friday as a northeast monsoon gradually reaches the eastern Guangdong coast.

The Observatory said a few showers would continue over the weekend, with clearer weather and cooler mornings early next week, and lows of about 24 or 25 degrees. As of the evening warning summary, the Very Hot Weather Warning issued at 11.15am on 28 September and the yellow fire danger warning issued at 6am on Thursday remained in force. No thunderstorm warning was listed as in force.
The Labour Department had issued a yellow Heat Stress at Work Warning at 11.30am. Outdoor workers and people watching the evening harbour events were among those exposed to the residual heat.

zh.headline: 天文台料今晚有驟雨 東北季候風明日起影響
zh.dek: 晚上6時30分報告指多處下午高見34度，今晚及明日有驟雨及雷暴，明日氣溫約27至31度。
body: 香港天文台晚上6時30分發出的報告表示，高溫觸發的驟雨及雷暴正影響廣東沿岸，本港下午多處氣溫上升至34度或以上。
天文台預料，今晚及明日漸轉多雲，有幾陣驟雨及雷暴，明日部分地區雨勢較大，氣溫介乎27至31度。風勢微弱，明日漸轉和緩東至東北風，一股東北季候風會逐漸影響廣東東部沿岸。
天文台展望周末仍有幾陣驟雨，下周初至中天色較為明朗，早上稍涼，最低氣溫下降至約24、25度。截至晚間警告摘要，9月28日上午11時15分發出的酷熱天氣警告，以及周四上午6時發出的黃色火災危險警告仍然生效。當時並無雷暴警告生效。
勞工處上午11時30分發出黃色工作暑熱警告。戶外工作人士及晚間留在海濱活動的市民，仍會感到餘熱。
